previous_action: Gaius Maximus Valerius returns to his estate and begins ensuring that the estate's production facilities remain sustainable. Timber, cultivated land, water sources, livestock resources and other productive inputs are to be managed so that consumption does not exceed the rate at which the estate can replenish them, while existing facilities are maintained and new ones are planned around sustainable supply.

continuity.campaign_development: Valerius returned from the completed bandit expedition and resumed direct administration of the expanded estate. Production facilities, timber, agricultural land, water sources, workshops, the lake port and roads are now being managed under a sustainability and maintenance system intended to keep recurring resource consumption below replenishment and productive capacity. The estate's military force remains intact and highly organized, while the immediate emphasis has shifted from expansion to durable production.

special_event_policy.rarity_rule: Higher magnitude events are increasingly rare; magnitude is selected only when justified by unusually consequential circumstances.
special_event_policy.influence_rule: Event influence increases exponentially with magnitude rather than linearly.
